tasks.answer: Deleting a discussion uses ConfirmationDialog, imported from '@/components/ui/dialog' (barrel re-exports './dialog' and './confirmation-dialog'). Required props: triggerButton (ReactElement), confirmButton (ReactElement), title (string). Optional: body, cancelButtonText, icon ('danger'|'info'), isDone. DeleteDiscussion wraps it in <Authorization allowedRoles={[ROLES.ADMIN]}> and passes icon="danger", body, and a destructive Button as confirmButton.

The login form uses Input (exported from '@/components/ui/form', defined in components/ui/form/input.tsx). It binds react-hook-form via the required `registration` prop, typed Partial<UseFormRegisterReturn>, supplied as registration={register('email')} / register('password') inside the <Form> render-prop children ({ register, formState }). Input spreads {...registration} onto the native <input>; label and error (FieldError) are optional FieldWrapperPassThroughProps used for display.

Pagination of the discussion list is TablePagination (exported from components/ui/table/pagination.tsx, which also exports TablePaginationProps). It is NOT re-exported by the '@/components/ui/table' barrel (index.ts only exports './table'); it is normally passed to <Table pagination={{ totalPages, currentPage, rootUrl }} /> and Table renders <TablePagination {...pagination} />. Required props: totalPages (number), currentPage (number), rootUrl (string, used to build `${rootUrl}?page=N` links).

Markdown bodies are rendered safely with MDPreview from '@/components/ui/md-preview'. Its single input prop is `value: string` (raw markdown). Inside, marked `parse(value)` output is sanitized with DOMPurify.sanitize and injected through dangerouslySetInnerHTML, so raw HTML is sanitized. Used as <MDPreview value={discussion.body} /> in DiscussionView.

Discussion creation is handled by CreateDiscussion from '@/features/discussions/components/create-discussion' (no props). It requires the ADMIN role: it is wrapped in <Authorization allowedRoles={[ROLES.ADMIN]}> (ROLES from '@/lib/authorization'), so non-admins get the default forbiddenFallback of null. It renders a FormDrawer + Form (createDiscussionInputSchema) with Title Input and Body Textarea.

notes: No catalog CLI/catalog JSON used. Strategy: listed apps/react-vite with find, then located candidates by filename under src/components/ui and src/features/discussions, read each candidate fully with the read tool, and cross-checked real usage with grep (rg not installed; used grep -rn) in delete-discussion.tsx, discussions-list.tsx, discussions.tsx, discussion-view.tsx, create-discussion.tsx. Key uncertainty resolved: the '@/components/ui/table' barrel does NOT re-export pagination.tsx, so TablePagination must be imported from '@/components/ui/table/pagination' or supplied via Table's `pagination` prop; Table itself is imported from '@/components/ui/table'. Other apps (nextjs-app/nextjs-pages) contain duplicates and were ignored except one grep to confirm duplication of the pagination pattern. Command count includes one failed `rg` invocation (rg: command not found).
